rootCause: The 09ZF scope guard is not detecting a runtime regression. diffNames() unions `git diff --name-only` with ALL untracked files (minus a hardcoded protected list), and the allowed-file assertion then requires every entry to appear in a small fixed allowlist. Any untracked file whatsoever — including a harmless evidence note that cannot affect runtime — is therefore reported as a disallowed runtime/package/env/database/frontend/production change. Condition B reproduces the exact failing assertion string observed in both independent R17 gate cycles, using a file with no runtime meaning at all.
guardLivenessEvidence: Condition C fails correctly on a planted server.js change, so the guard is genuinely live and is not a dead assertion. Any remedy must preserve this.
trueRuntimeRegressionEvidence: Condition A passes 18/18 with 187 assertions on a truly clean tree, including every safe-LOA controlled_loa_answer case, every excluded unsafe query, and the unrelated-tax-query routing checks. The controlled LOA runtime is therefore not regressed.
contaminationCorroboration: The independent gate evidence showed an in-progress review directory and a modified R17 all-26 evidence file present during execution — both are untracked-or-modified paths of exactly the kind Condition B proves sufficient to fail the suite on its own.

remedy.laneA: R18 gate execution discipline: all capture outside the repository, no evidence imported until the gate process terminates, clean tracked tree and protected-only untracked paths verified before every cycle.
remedy.laneB: Narrow the guard's CLASSIFICATION so evidence/report artifacts that cannot affect runtime are not counted as runtime/package/env/database/frontend/production changes. The guard is not disabled, no arbitrary runtime file is excluded, and every ignored class requires an explicit negative control.
remedy.laneC: Not applicable. No runtime or ordering fix is warranted, and none will be made.
